verdict.rationale: Databricks SQL docs say users can inspect a query's execution plan to identify bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and that the product gives automatic insights and recommendations when queries run inefficiently. That covers the core of diagnosing slow queries, but both are one-line first-party mentions. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of query-profile details (operator-level metrics, time and spill breakdowns), evidence linking profiles to cost or expense attribution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
